# seedless

> seedless is a money app for people who get paid in dollars. sign up with face id or a fingerprint, no seed phrase. hold usdc in your own account, send for free with gas covered, and pay out to any nigerian bank account in minutes. built on solana by seedless labs.

seedless is non-custodial: users hold their own dollars. live on the iphone app store, google play and the solana dapp store since 24 sept 2026.

## key pages
- [home](https://www.seedlesslabs.xyz/): what seedless is
- [how it works](https://www.seedlesslabs.xyz/how-it-works): sign up, receive, pay out
- [features](https://www.seedlesslabs.xyz/features): what you can do
- [fees](https://www.seedlesslabs.xyz/fees): 0.5% to pay a nigerian bank or swap. holding, receiving and sending are free
- [faq](https://www.seedlesslabs.xyz/faq): common questions
- [download](https://www.seedlesslabs.xyz/download): app store, google play, solana dapp store
- [developers](https://www.seedlesslabs.xyz/developers): open-source repos and the stack
- [changelog](https://www.seedlesslabs.xyz/changelog): what changed, with [rss](https://www.seedlesslabs.xyz/changelog.xml)
- [services](https://www.seedlesslabs.xyz/services): paid build work from seedless labs
- [security](https://www.seedlesslabs.xyz/security): how we handle security
- [support](https://www.seedlesslabs.xyz/support): get help

## open source
- [github.com/seedless-labs](https://github.com/seedless-labs): leash, leash-pay, strom, hermes-money-rules, passkey-dwallet-controller, deadcheque, mermail-settle-to-bank
